g.text: deploy.yml after helm upgrade, every environment (make deploy, check-release.sh)

text.tspan: The reset window: prod by commit with
keep-unhealthy, before the tag is pushed
Tag TAG added to the image
back to the last deployed revision
A newer push to the same branch
The newer run waits until this one ends;
of several that wait only the newest starts,
the others are cancelled before they begin
staging ran its commit of main
then tag vYYYY.N.P, the GitHub release,
the pull request back into main
check once more; the job fails
